subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: drive solve create suffer occur reach cause carry violate give Traffic jam is common affair in big cities of our country. Increasing number of vehicles (a) ⎯⎯ traffic jam. Mainly, it (b) ⎯⎯ in the congested areas. Overtaking tendency also (c) ⎯⎯ traffic jam. Some drivers (d) ⎯⎯ the traffic rules and (e) ⎯⎯ carelessly. It (f) ⎯⎯ a lot of pains to the people. Ambulances (g) ⎯⎯ patients cannot (h) ⎯⎯ hospital timely. Students and office going people also (i) ⎯⎯ due to traffic jam. This problem should be (j) ⎯⎯ immediately.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) create (b) occurs (c) causes (d) violate (e) drive (f) gives (g) carrying (h) reach (i) suffer (j) solved
